name: Korva Skybreaker
source_profile:
Stonekeeper Korva Skybreaker (LG)

Korva is an imposing and widely respected clan leader charged with maintaining agreements between the principal Highcairn settlements. She believes the mountain passes must remain open to peaceful travelers, but refuses to allow outsiders to establish permanent military strongholds within Highcairn territory. Korva is particularly concerned by the growing activity of prospectors, mercenary engineers, and mysterious travelers near abandoned dwarven tunnels.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 58 (source excerpt; may be partial)
